spec_match.rationale: The dual-session metric design is sound, but on not-allowed the code silently fills both panels with canned transcripts and sets status to plain 'Idle' (simulateFallback, source lines 259-277) — the static banner pre-declares simulation mode, yet nothing marks the displayed run itself as simulated.

interactive.rationale: Start-both/stop and language select work; the driven run populated the metrics table (129 vs 123 chars, +6 punctuation marks).

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised punctuation-count/diff quality panel.

edge_cases.rationale: Mic-denied triggers the simulation, but that transition is invisible at the moment it happens.

references.rationale: No chromestatus link or external references on the page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 4 pass / 2 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: started both sessions; the fallback populated metrics and diff with zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: Status dot+text exist but are not a live region, and the simulated-vs-real distinction is not conveyed at all.

openQuestions.title: Mark simulation runs as simulated in the live status
openQuestions.detail: When rec.onerror('not-allowed') routes to simulateFallback(), setStatus('idle') is called and canned transcripts render indistinguishably from real ones; set the status to 'Simulation (microphone unavailable)' and badge the panels so the displayed metrics are never mistaken for a live measurement.

guidanceConsulted.query: review pass: accessible live output, honest capability fallbacks, keyboard operability for existing concept demo
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Verify semantic controls, live-region announcements for async state, visible focus, and honest unsupported states rather than fake success.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Review-only critique (no frontend change shipped with it): the rubric applied this guidance as the review bar; the page itself was not modified.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless-Chrome CDP drive of the page's controls on 2026-08-16 with console/network capture.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: 'Start both sessions' hit the denied mic and silently switched to the canned simulation — metrics table filled (+6 punctuation marks) with status just 'Idle'; the banner pre-declares simulation mode but the run itself is unmarked; zero console errors.
